content:
Context: 3. Stepping up

3. other relevant rule/ order.
4. The stepping up of pay is admissible with reference to the first junior (not necessarily immediate junior) on only one occasion; but if the junior concerned gets his pay stepped up at par with one junior to him,
4. then the pay of the senior may again be stepped up.
5. The junior should not have been drawing more pay than the senior from time to time in the lower post.
